name: TAFE Queensland Scholarship Program
summary: 100 scholarships of $5,000 a year, including access and equity awards, for new TAFE Queensland students and first-year apprentices.
key: Each year 100 x $5,000 scholarships are awarded.
who: First-year apprentice, or planning to enrol in a Certificate III or higher in Semester 1 of the following year.
Categories: access and equity, merit, athlete merit, and career pathway merit.
how: Complete the online application form in one session with proof of identity and citizenship plus supporting evidence.
catches: Applications open in July and close towards the end of September; the 2027 round is closed.
Paid as $3,000 after study starts and $2,000 at a course milestone.

evidence.quote: Each year 100 x $5,000 scholarships are awarded to people looking to change their lives and build lifelong careers.
must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident.
Scholarship applications open in July and close towards the end of September
